instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Stop sending or queueing notices for one of my devices", and give it device_id.
2. The AI calls do_one_thing_in_my_account at @tools with method tools:run, tool tool:remove-my-notification-device and its input (the worked example shows one).
3. Read what comes back: Pass the opaque device_id from my-notification-devices.
4. It reads only its own rows, from the rows its caller gives it, and answers the rows it makes as keep for the caller to keep: notification-device.
